data.one_liner: Integrates Snapchat CameraKit features into Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides seamless access to Snapchat CameraKit functionality, allowing developers to open the camera, load specific or group lenses, and retrieve captured media such as images and videos.
use_when: You want to integrate Snapchat CameraKit lenses into your Flutter app.
You need to capture images or record videos using Snapchat's camera features.
avoid_when: You only need a basic device camera preview without Snapchat lenses.
You want a pure Dart solution without native configuration overhead for Android and iOS.
strengths: Direct integration with Snapchat CameraKit SDK.
Supports loading both group lenses and single lenses by ID.
Handles both image and video media results.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
Requires proper API tokens and app approval from the Snap Kit Portal.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding meta-data in AndroidManifest.xml, configuring Info.plist keys for iOS, updating minSdk to 21, setting up AppCompat theme for Android, and configuring camera/microphone permissions.
